EXAMPLE COUNTY ZONING ORDINANCE
Code version 2026-06-30

Article 1 General Provisions

Sec. 1-1 Title

This ordinance is the Example County Zoning Ordinance.
It regulates land in the unincorporated area.

Sec. 1-2 Purpose

Districts separate light assembly from uses that bring noise, odor, dust, or outdoor storage.
An applicant reads one district column and one use row together.

Sec. 1-3 Districts established

The industrial districts are I-1 Light Industrial and I-2 Heavy Industrial.
PD-1 Planned Development is mapped case by case.

Article 2 Definitions

Sec. 2-1 Definitions

Warehouse means a building used to keep finished goods before they are shipped to another site.

Battery energy storage system means equipment that stores electricity for later dispatch.

Medical marijuana treatment center means a licensed facility devoted to cultivation or processing of medical marijuana.

Heavy industry means a primary use that fabricates durable goods and conducts substantial outdoor operations.

The equipment yard on Bessemer Road is inside the industrial area and is not a separate district.

Article 3 District Purpose

Sec. 3-1 I-1 Light Industrial

I-1 provides sites for assembly and similar work inside a building.
Outdoor operations in I-1 are limited to a side yard.

Sec. 3-2 I-2 Heavy Industrial

I-2 provides sites for heavy industry and for uses that need large lots or outdoor yards.

Sec. 3-3 Work indoors

Light assembly and manufac-
turing of durable goods may locate in I-1 when the work stays indoors.

Article 4 Use Regulations

Sec. 4-1 How to read the table

Read a row across the district columns.
A symbol applies only to that row and that column.

Sec. 4-2 Table of Permitted Uses

Columns: I-1 Light Industrial, I-2 Heavy Industrial, PD-1 Planned Development.

Key: P = permitted, C = conditional use permit, blank = not permitted.

Warehouse | I-1 Light Industrial | P
Warehouse | I-2 Heavy Industrial | P
Warehouse | PD-1 Planned Development | C
Battery energy storage system | I-1 Light Industrial | C
Battery energy storage system | I-2 Heavy Industrial | P
Battery energy storage system | PD-1 Planned Development | C
Medical marijuana treatment center | I-1 Light Industrial | C
Medical marijuana treatment center | I-2 Heavy Industrial | C
Medical marijuana treatment center | PD-1 Planned Development | C
Heavy industry | I-1 Light Industrial | (blank = not permitted)
Heavy industry | I-2 Heavy Industrial | P
Heavy industry | PD-1 Planned Development | C

Sec. 4-3 Uses not listed

Any use not listed in Table 4-2 is prohibited.

Sec. 4-4 Conditional use permits

A conditional use permit is a discretionary approval.
The approving body may add conditions on traffic, screening, and hours.

Sec. 4-5 Planned development

Uses in PD districts are set by the rezoning case conditions.
A PD-1 approval does not amend the table for I-1 or I-2.

Sec. 4-7 Records

The planning department keeps the official zoning map and the adopted table.
A zoning verification letter repeats the district and the row from those records.
